# Test fixtures

No market-data fixtures have been collected in Phase 0.

Future fixtures should be small and checked in with their source, retrieval date,
units, interval convention, and any edits documented alongside them. Label
synthetic edge cases explicitly. Include ambiguous/nonexistent local times,
late arrivals, exact repeats, and material revisions when those behaviors exist.

Unit tests must read local fixtures without live CAISO calls or cloud credentials.
Do not store credentials, private data, or bulk downloads here.
